reason: My doctor said my magnesium could be low, and this is the first one that shows a named lab and a batch report I can actually check, with the dose on the box. At the $24.99 launch price I would try one box, but not the $29.99 one.
objection: $29.99 is more than Toplux or Goli, and it is a brand-new product with no reviews yet. I would want to open the lab report myself before I trust it.
would_change_my_mind: Real customer reviews, or the lab report showing the tested amount matches 200 mg. Seeing the price stay at $24.99 after the launch.
